text: Agile methodology is a popular way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses items from a prioritized list called the backlog. These items are often written as user stories, which describe features from the customer's point of view. During the sprint, the team holds short daily meetings known as standups to share progress and problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to adapt quickly to changes and deliver useful results regularly.
